evidence.text: Two fish 冉 caught on a line 一
Origin unclear. Possibly contains 二 (two) as a component, to convey the meaning "second time; again".
Cognate with 載 (OC *ʔslɯːʔ, “year”), 茲 (OC *ʔsɯ, “year”), 薦 (OC *ʔseːns, “repeatedly”), 洊 (OC *zlɯːns, “again; repeatedly”), 荐 (OC *zlɯːns, “repeatedly”) (Schuessler, 2007).
